GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Copilot are distinct products from the same parent company, plus the word is used generically for any AI assistant.
Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry) vs generic industry use of 'foundry' for chip fabs (TSMC) or metalworking.
Tesla Optimus the humanoid robot vs the Transformers character, a frequent false-positive in casual text.
1X's NEO robot vs The Matrix character vs unrelated product names using the same word.
Amazon Bedrock the model platform vs the ordinary geological term.
Boston Dynamics' Atlas robot vs other programs and products using the same name across industries.
Runway's 'Gen' model line vs the generic short form of 'generation' used throughout AI product naming.
